description: This source file implements a dedicated SPI backend driver for Host Commands on STM32 microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS. It manages SPI communication, DMA setup, GPIO callbacks, and power management for the host command interface.

methods.name: dma_callback
methods.description: DMA transfer completion callback handling transmission end and preparing for reception.

methods.name: prepare_rx
methods.description: Prepares the SPI interface to receive data by reloading DMA and setting status.

methods.name: spi_configure
methods.description: Configures SPI parameters such as mode, polarity, phase, and data width.

methods.name: wait_for_rx_bytes
methods.description: Waits until the specified number of bytes are received via DMA or timeout occurs.

methods.name: gpio_cb_nss
methods.description: GPIO callback for handling chip select line changes, managing SPI state transitions.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_spi_init
methods.description: Initializes the SPI backend with RX and TX buffers, GPIO callbacks, and DMA setup.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_spi_send
methods.description: Prepares and initiates sending a response over SPI using DMA.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_backend_get_spi
methods.description: Provides the SPI backend instance with configured chip select GPIO.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_spi_stm32_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions (suspend/resume) for the SPI device.
